extracted.intended_audience: academics and scholars asked to review journal manuscripts / peer reviewers
extracted.subtask_description: Practical, general-purpose guidance for scholars preparing written peer reviews of journal manuscripts, covering acceptance decision, reading strategy, documenting issues, and writing recommendations to authors and editors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verify your expertise
rubrics_metrics.description: Verify your expertise before accepting the review assignment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check journal guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Check journal guidelines — go to the journal page for any specific reviewer instructions and confirm format compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Skim the paper first
rubrics_metrics.description: Skim the paper first — quickly read through to understand general content; underline key arguments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Read critically
rubrics_metrics.description: Read critically — ask whether the research question is valuable, data appropriate, results novel.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document major issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Document major issues — take notes about major, moderate and minor revisions needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create a checklist
rubrics_metrics.description: Create a checklist — verify citations actually support the claims authors make.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assess writing quality
rubrics_metrics.description: Assess writing quality — language, grammar, flow, clarity, fit for the journal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for prior publication
rubrics_metrics.description: Check for prior publication — review author histories and related research to ensure no previous publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify common errors
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify common errors in methodology or analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Summarize for the editor
rubrics_metrics.description: Summarize for the editor — overview, contribution, strengths, weaknesses, acceptability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide specific recommendations
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide specific recommendations — actionable suggestions, target two to three pages (four max).

rubrics_metrics.name: Make a recommendation
rubrics_metrics.description: Make a recommendation — accept / revise / reject, clearly stated to the editor.
